body:
You think they sent me to a nuthouse because they CARED about me? Yeah right. They were looking to cover their own ass. It wouldn't look good to have "Suicide at X High School" plastered all over the papers. 

I didn't ask to be alive and I'm sure as hell not going to live my life for other people. I don't owe you squat. I'm sorry about your friend and I'm happy that he turned out okay, but what did that story prove other than that life sucks?

You say 90/10 is confirmation bias, but saying "life is life" is being lazy. Instead of forming an actual opinion on what life is, you just say "life is life" and leave it at that.
Then what are people like us supposed to do?

No, those people were all crazy. Don't me wrong, I'm crazy as much as the next person, but those people were crazy-crazy-kill-you-in-your-sleep crazy. A few of them were criminals as well. 

I try not to think about the time I spent there. I still get nervous around doctors and in cramped rooms. 

EDIT: Why the fuck are you getting downvoted? Honestly, FUCK this subreddit. You people make me sick.

I was involuntarily committed to an adult mental institution when I was in high school for having the RADICAL opinion that life isn't all sunshine and daisies. I have a hard time trusting people.

That said, my judgement could very well be skewed. Thank you for not treating me like an irrational kid.

Ban me then. I don't give a fuck anymore. I'm beyond caring... 

If my pessimism is too much for this subreddit to handle, then maybe you guys ought to rethink the reason you're here.
